meta.note: Actionable setups/tricks (not 'collect X' / 'find X'). Speeds from minecraft.wiki/w/Transportation. '(inferred)' marks values not read from a source.

tricks.name: Bucket-cast a Nether portal (no diamond pick)
tricks.what: Build the obsidian frame in place by pouring lava into a mold and setting it with water, so you reach the Nether on day 1 without mining obsidian.
steps: Find a surface lava pool (or ruined portal)
Make a mold of dirt/cobble for each of the 10 frame blocks
Pour lava into a slot, then water over it to turn it into obsidian; pick the water back up
Repeat for all 10 frame blocks (corners not needed)
Light with flint_and_steel or a fire charge
tricks.why: Skips the diamond pickaxe requirement; Nether access (gold, quartz, blaze rods, 8:1 travel) on day 1.
tricks.needs: Iron for 2 buckets; a lava source.
tricks.version_notes: Minimum frame is 4x5 with corners optional = 10 obsidian.

tricks.name: Link portals with the 8:1 coordinate rule
tricks.what: Divide Overworld X/Z by 8 to get the Nether spot (multiply by 8 going back) and build the matching portal there yourself so portals link exactly where you want.
steps: Note Overworld portal X,Z (F3)
Divide by 8 for the Nether target
Build the Nether-side portal at those coordinates before travelling back through
Keep other portals far enough apart that they don't capture each other
tricks.why: 1 Nether block = 8 Overworld blocks of travel; avoids portals linking to the wrong place or spawning in a cliff.
tricks.version_notes: Overworld search radius for an existing portal is 128 blocks, Nether 16 (wiki).

tricks.name: Portal to the Nether roof
tricks.what: Break through the bedrock ceiling once, build a portal on the Nether roof, and use the flat, mob-free roof as your highway and farm site.
steps: Get under the bedrock ceiling (top ~y 123-127)
Break one bedrock block (piston/TNT method, see 'bedrock-breaking') or pearl glitch
Climb onto the roof (y 128+) and build a portal there
Link an Overworld portal to it with the 8:1 rule so you arrive straight on the roof
tricks.why: No natural mob spawns on the roof, flat 8x travel, ideal place for ice/boat highways and many technical farms (ianxofour builds several there).
tricks.needs: Nether access; bedrock-breaking kit; 'nether roof' is not where the portal search puts you by default - must build the portal yourself.
tricks.version_notes: Works in 1.21.x. Some servers (Paper) disable roof access by config.
tricks.confidence: high for mechanics; bedrock Y range from memory (medium)

tricks.name: Break bedrock with pistons + TNT
tricks.what: Use an exploding-piston setup to delete a bedrock block, opening the Nether roof or the End exit portal area.
steps: Place a piston facing up under the target bedrock (head into the bedrock)
Place TNT next to it and a lever on the piston
Light TNT, flick lever on/off at the right moment so the piston retracts as TNT explodes
The piston ends up flipped; retracting it removes the bedrock
tricks.why: One-time unlock for the Nether roof (and bedrock-breaking pistons for wither cages etc.).
tricks.version_notes: Wiki tags the exploding-piston method as valid through 1.21. Headless-piston method (MC-27056) is the mass version.
tricks.confidence: medium-high - wiki lists it for 1.21; bug-based so could be fixed in a later version

tricks.name: Portal next to a Nether lava ocean for fuel
tricks.what: Put a portal (or mark one) beside a Nether lava sea and scoop lava buckets in bulk to fuel furnaces.
steps: Find a lava ocean (y ~31 sea level in Nether)
Build a small safe platform with a portal next to it
Fill buckets (stack many empty buckets in a shulker)
Use 1 lava bucket per 100 smelts
tricks.why: 1 lava_bucket smelts 100 items vs 8 for coal; a lava ocean is effectively infinite.
tricks.version_notes: Nether lava sea level is y 31 (inferred from memory).

tricks.name: Dripstone lava cauldron generator
tricks.what: A lava source above a block with pointed dripstone under it slowly fills cauldrons below with lava; build many to get renewable lava in the Overworld.
steps: Place lava source on top of a block
Hang pointed_dripstone under that block (tip down)
Put a cauldron under the tip (within 10 blocks, clear gap)
Build a row of these, ideally in loaded chunks; collect with a bucket (or a dispenser with empty buckets) - hoppers cannot empty cauldrons (inferred)
tricks.why: Renewable lava = renewable fuel (100 smelts per bucket) without Nether trips.
tricks.needs: Dripstone caves (or wandering trader) for pointed_dripstone.
tricks.version_notes: Lava: 15/256 chance per random tick to fill an empty cauldron; average refill nearly one MC day (~19+ min) per cauldron. Water version: 45/256 per level.

tricks.name: Infinite water source (2x2 or 3-long)
tricks.what: Pour two water buckets into a 2x2 or 1x3 hole to create a water source you can scoop from forever.
steps: Dig a 2x2 hole one deep
Pour water in opposite corners
Scoop endlessly
tricks.why: Endless water for farms, MLG buckets, portal casting, without walking to a river.
tricks.version_notes: Water does not regenerate in the Nether (evaporates).

tricks.name: Tame and saddle a horse early
tricks.what: Tame a horse in plains/savanna by repeatedly mounting it, saddle it, and keep it near base; later breed for speed.
steps: Find horses in plains/savanna
Mount repeatedly until hearts appear (feeding sugar/apples/wheat raises temper)
Put on a saddle (from chests/fishing/trading)
Use a lead to bring it home; breed with golden carrots for faster offspring
tricks.why: Fastest horses reach ~14.57 m/s vs 5.6 sprinting (about 2.6x), with jump boost for terrain.
tricks.needs: A saddle (structure chests, fishing, master leatherworker).
tricks.version_notes: Saddles became craftable in 1.21.6 (3 leather + 1 iron ingot) (inferred - verify).
tricks.confidence: high for speed; medium for 1.21.6 saddle recipe

tricks.name: Water skiing behind a dolphin (ianxofour)
tricks.what: Leash a dolphin and get towed while swimming with Dolphin's Grace, covering 2200-3100 blocks per minute of ocean with no prep build.
steps: Find a dolphin in an ocean
Attach a lead and swim/sprint to get Dolphin's Grace
Launch and steer by looking; surface to breathe without stopping
Watch for autosave lag that can snap the lead (every 5 min)
tricks.why: 2200-3100 blocks/min (~37-52 b/s) early-game exploration to find jungles, mushroom fields, badlands.
tricks.needs: Leads (slime_ball + string or llama drops); an ocean.
tricks.version_notes: Video tested Java 1.16-1.19; lead mechanics were reworked in 1.21.6 (inferred - not tested).
tricks.confidence: medium - numbers from ianxofour's description; 1.21.6 leash changes may affect it

tricks.name: Blue/packed ice boat highway in the Nether
tricks.what: Lay a 1-wide ice track with walls on the Nether roof or in a tunnel and ride a boat along it.
steps: Get ice (silk touch, wandering trader blue ice, or craft 9 ice->packed, 9 packed->blue)
Lay a straight track with side walls/slabs
Place boat and ride; use blue ice for max speed
tricks.why: Boat on blue ice ~72.73 m/s, ice ~40 m/s; in the Nether that's x8 Overworld distance.

materials.note: per block of track; packed_ice/ice cheaper but slower

tricks.needs: Silk Touch (for ice) or crafting 81 ice per blue ice; Nether roof or tunnel.

tricks.name: Nether hub with spoke tunnels
tricks.what: Build one central Nether hub with tunnels (or ice roads) to each linked Overworld portal: base, farms, villages, End stronghold.
steps: Pick hub at your base's /8 coords
Run straight tunnels on axes to each destination
Build each linked portal at exact /8 coordinates
Light/slab tunnels to stop spawns
tricks.why: Turns long Overworld trips into short Nether walks; one network for the whole world.
tricks.needs: Diamond pick or lava casting, Nether access.

tricks.name: Elytra + firework rocket travel
tricks.what: Fly with elytra boosted by rockets; repair with Mending.
steps: Get elytra from an End city ship
Craft rockets: 1 gunpowder + 1 paper = 3 rockets (flight 1)
Put Unbreaking III + Mending on elytra
Take off from height or jump+activate, then rocket
tricks.why: ~33.5 m/s continuous rocket boost in any direction, ignoring terrain.
tricks.needs: End access, gunpowder source (creeper farm or trading).

tricks.name: Open End gateways (kill dragon / respawn dragon)
tricks.what: Each dragon kill opens a new end gateway; throw an ender pearl into one to reach the outer End islands (cities, elytra, shulkers).
steps: Kill the dragon (see dragon trap)
Optionally respawn with 4 end_crystals for more gateways (up to 20)
Throw ender pearl into the gateway
tricks.why: Access to End cities = elytra + shulker shells (shulker boxes).

tricks.name: Ender Dragon Death Trap (ianxofour)
tricks.what: Pillar to Y145, place an obsidian block at X0 Z0 above the exit portal with water on it; the perching dragon gets stuck and you shoot or punch it to death.
steps: Destroy crystals as usual
Pillar up to Y145 with dirt, bridge to X0 Z0
Place obsidian at X0 Z0, remove last bridge block, place water on top
Wait for the dragon to perch/get caught, then shoot (Punch bow OK)
tricks.why: Among the safest and fastest dragon kills; reusable for respawned dragons.
tricks.version_notes: Tested 1.16+, reported working from 1.14.2. Dragon more aggressive in 1.18+; invisibility potion (no armor) recommended.
tricks.confidence: medium-high - from ianxofour's description; not confirmed for 1.21.x

tricks.name: Instant Lazy Mob Switch (ianxofour)
tricks.what: Trap mobs (e.g. silverfish from a stronghold spawner) in a lazy chunk next to a chunk loader; they count toward the mob cap but never despawn, so you can turn off hostile spawning on demand.
steps: Pick a stronghold silverfish spawner site
Build the trap and chunk loader per the video/WDL
Stock the trap until mob cap fills
Turn on/off by loading/unloading the lazy chunk
tricks.why: Stops natural hostile spawns in a dimension (great for building, or boosting specific farms like raid/spawner farms).
tricks.needs: Stronghold, chunk loader knowledge. Affects all players in that dimension.
tricks.version_notes: Java 1.17+. Vanilla-only; not for modified servers. Other mob options: shulkers, wardens, pillagers, vexes.
tricks.confidence: medium - from video description; exact material list in video not extracted

tricks.name: Voidless Void Trading (ianxofour)
tricks.what: Use minecart tracks to move a villager out of loaded range (and back) so trades lock prices; you can trade with an un-restocked/cheap villager repeatedly.
steps: Pick a site away from spawn chunks
Build villager track + player track (rails count differs SP vs server)
Lock in a discounted price, then send the villager away/back
Block the villager's eye box with glass/top slab
tricks.why: Keeps discounted prices locked (e.g. after curing/Hero) for bulk trading; works in any dimension, cheap early.
tricks.needs: Villager with good trade; avoid spawn chunks.
tricks.version_notes: Java 1.17-1.19; ianxofour notes unannounced changes in 1.19.4+ broke/changed it. Treat as unverified for 1.21.x; end gateway void trading is the standard alternative.
tricks.confidence: low - author flagged it as affected by 1.19.4+ changes

tricks.name: Villager trading hall
tricks.what: Put villagers in 1x1 cells with their workstation so you can trade with each from a corridor.
steps: Breed/transport villagers (boat, minecart, rail)
Lock each in a cell with a workstation
Assign professions, reroll for good trades
Add a bed nearby is not required for trading
tricks.why: Mending/enchanted books, diamond gear, emeralds from crops/sticks in one place.
tricks.version_notes: Villager Trade Rebalance experiment (biome-based librarian books) is opt-in; cartographer + wandering trader parts shipped in 1.21.5.

tricks.name: Reroll librarians for Mending
tricks.what: Place and break a lectern next to an unemployed or never-traded librarian until it offers the book you want.
steps: Put villager in a cell
Place lectern, check trades
If wrong, break lectern and re-place
Once the target book shows, trade once to lock it
tricks.why: Guaranteed Mending, Efficiency, Protection etc. at low cost; Mending on all gear.
tricks.needs: A villager; works only until you trade with it.
tricks.version_notes: With the Trade Rebalance experiment on, books are biome-limited (Mending only from swamp master librarian).

tricks.name: Zombie-cure villagers for big discounts
tricks.what: Let a zombie convert a traded villager, then cure it with Weakness + golden apple to get permanent price discounts.
steps: Trap villager; let a zombie infect it (Hard difficulty = guaranteed conversion)
Throw splash Weakness and feed a golden_apple
Wait 3-5 min (iron bars/beds nearby speed it slightly)
Trade at reduced prices (often 1 emerald)
tricks.why: Permanent discounts; trades like Mending for ~1 emerald (commonly reported).
tricks.needs: Brewing (fermented spider eye), gold, a zombie, Hard difficulty for 100% conversion.
tricks.version_notes: Wiki: curing the same villager more than once gives no additional discount.
tricks.confidence: high for mechanics; '1 emerald' result is commonly reported, not wiki-quoted

tricks.name: Move villagers by boat/minecart
tricks.what: Trap a villager in a boat (works on land) or minecart to drag it to your trading hall.
steps: Place boat in villager's path
Push/lure it in
Break and re-place the path or paddle on land/water to drag it home
tricks.why: Fast way to start a trading hall without building a breeder first.

tricks.name: Enchanting table with 15 bookshelves
tricks.what: Surround an enchanting table with 15 bookshelves one block away to unlock level-30 enchants.
steps: Craft table (4 obsidian, 2 diamonds, 1 book)
Place 15 bookshelves with a 1-block air gap ring
Use lapis + 30 levels for best results; add anvil + grindstone
tricks.why: Level-30 enchants (Efficiency IV/Fortune III/Protection IV possible).
tricks.needs: Diamonds, obsidian, sugarcane + leather for books.

tricks.name: Duplicate the netherite upgrade template
tricks.what: Copy your first netherite_upgrade_smithing_template so you never need another bastion.
steps: Get 1 template (guaranteed in bastion treasure chest)
Craft template + netherrack + diamonds -> 2 templates
Keep one spare at all times
tricks.why: Each netherite piece needs a template; duping saves bastion runs.

materials.note: (standard recipe; wiki fetch summary said 'a diamond')

tricks.version_notes: Since 1.20.
tricks.confidence: high - 7 diamonds from memory, yield 2 from wiki

tricks.name: Bed/TNT mining for ancient debris
tricks.what: Strip-mine at the debris-rich Y level in the Nether and blow up walls with beds or TNT (debris is blast resistant and remains).
steps: Go to Y ~15 in the Nether
Mine long tunnels
Place a bed in the wall and click it (explodes) or use TNT
Pick up exposed ancient_debris
tricks.why: Much faster netherite than hand mining.
tricks.version_notes: Best Y around 13-15 (from memory).

tricks.name: Branch-mine at the right Y for diamonds
tricks.what: Run branch tunnels near Y -58 (1.18+) with spacing, ideally with Fortune III.
steps: Dig down to Y ~-58
Mine main tunnel with side branches every 3-4 blocks
Fortune III on ores
tricks.why: Highest diamond density; Fortune multiplies yield.
tricks.version_notes: 1.18 changed ore distribution; diamonds most common near the bottom of the world.
tricks.confidence: medium - exact best Y from memory

tricks.name: Ominous bottle -> raid on demand
tricks.what: Kill a raid captain outside a raid to get an ominous bottle, drink it, and enter a village to start a raid (totems, emeralds, Hero of the Village discounts).
steps: Kill a banner-carrying pillager captain (outpost/patrol)
Pick up ominous_bottle
Drink, enter a village -> Raid Omen -> raid after 30 s
Win for Hero of the Village (trade discounts)
tricks.why: Totems of undying, emeralds, Hero discounts; feeds a raid farm.
tricks.version_notes: 1.21 (24w13a): killing a captain no longer grants Bad Omen directly; it drops an ominous bottle (levels I-V). Bad Omen near a trial spawner becomes Trial Omen instead.

tricks.name: Trial chamber + trial/ominous keys
tricks.what: Clear a trial chamber's spawners for trial keys to open vaults; with Bad Omen, ominous spawners/vaults give heavy core, enchanted books, better loot.
steps: Find trial chamber (Y deep, 1.21)
Beat spawners -> trial_key
Open vaults
Drink ominous bottle near spawners for Trial Omen, beat ominous spawners for ominous_trial_key
tricks.why: Breeze rods (wind charges, mace), enchanted books, heavy core; each vault opens once per player.
tricks.version_notes: Added 1.21. Trial Omen lasts 15 min x Bad Omen level.

tricks.name: Water-bucket clutch (and boat/ladder variants)
tricks.what: Place water (or a boat/scaffolding/ladder) just before landing to negate fall damage.
steps: Hold water bucket
Look down, click just before impact
Pick water back up
tricks.why: Fast descent from pillars, the dragon trap, mountains; saves lives.
tricks.version_notes: Water does not work in the Nether (use a boat, powder snow or hay).

tricks.name: Set spawn points (bed / respawn anchor)
tricks.what: Sleep in a bed at each new base and place a charged respawn anchor in the Nether so death doesn't send you back to world spawn.
steps: Place and right-click a bed (sets spawn)
In Nether: craft respawn_anchor (6 crying obsidian + 3 glowstone), charge with glowstone
Never click a bed in the Nether/End or an anchor in the Overworld (explodes)
tricks.why: Short corpse runs; skip nights and avoid phantoms.

tricks.name: Ender chest + shulker box logistics
tricks.what: Carry an ender chest; fill shulker boxes with gear, blocks, rockets and empty buckets; stash shulkers in the ender chest.
steps: Craft ender_chest (8 obsidian + eye of ender)
Get shulker shells (End city or shulker farm) -> shulker_box
Keep a kit shulker in ender chest
Mine with ender chest so death loses less
tricks.why: 27 slots x 27 = 729 stacks portable; safe storage across locations.
tricks.needs: End access for shulkers (ianxofour has an instant shulker farm).
tricks.version_notes: Bundles became full release in 1.21.2 (early-game mini storage).

tricks.name: Hopper item sorter / storage room
tricks.what: Build a hopper-line sorter with comparator filters that drops each item type into its own chest; add an overflow.
steps: Build hopper line over filter slices
Fill each filter hopper with the item + 4 dummy items (standard design)
Chests under each filter; overflow at end
tricks.why: Farm output auto-organized; minutes saved every session.
tricks.needs: Lots of iron (5 per hopper) - iron farm first.
tricks.version_notes: 1.21 crafter allows auto-crafting lines.

tricks.name: Ender pearl stasis chamber (teleport home)
tricks.what: Hold a thrown pearl floating in a bubble column; flipping a trapdoor drops it to teleport you back from anywhere (if the pearl's chunks are loaded).
steps: Build soul sand bubble column with a trapdoor on top
Throw pearl in so it hovers
Later trigger (lever/observer or a friend) to land it
tricks.why: Instant return to base/farm without portals.
tricks.needs: Chunk loaded when triggered; same dimension (pearls cross dimensions in newer versions - inferred).
tricks.version_notes: 1.21.2 (24w37a): thrown pearls load chunks around them; pearl stops loading chunks when the thrower logs off.
tricks.confidence: medium - chamber design is community-standard, not on wiki page

tricks.name: Bubble column elevator
tricks.what: Soul sand at the bottom of a water column pushes you up; magma pulls you down.
steps: Build 1x1 shaft of glass/kelp-placed sources
Soul_sand at bottom (up) or magma_block (down)
Use kelp trick to make all sources
tricks.why: Fast vertical travel in bases, to the dragon trap (end stone version), and between farm layers.

tricks.name: Place always-on farms in spawn chunks (and know they're small now)
tricks.what: Build compact always-active machines (sorters, iron, crop) in the 3x3 entity-processing spawn chunks.
steps: Find world spawn (compass/F3)
Locate the chunk; build within the 3x3
Alternatively use a chunk loader or /gamerule spawnChunkRadius in SP
tricks.why: Farms keep running while you're elsewhere.
tricks.version_notes: 1.20.5: spawn chunks default 3x3 entity-processing (+ ring of 16 lazy chunks), down from 19x19; spawnChunkRadius gamerule default 2.

tricks.name: AFK fishing spot (mending/books/saddles)
tricks.what: Build an open-water fishing setup where a pressure plate/note-block trick reels automatically while holding use (autoclicker/held key).
steps: Make a pool satisfying open water (5x4x5 around bobber of only water/air/lily pads)
Use a standard AFK design with item collection
Use Luck of the Sea III + Lure III + Mending rod
tricks.why: Treasure 5% -> 11.34% with LotS III: enchanted books, saddles, name tags; 1-6 XP per catch.
tricks.needs: Open water; holding right-click (game setting or held key).
tricks.version_notes: Open-water rule since 1.16 nerfed old 1x1 AFK farms; open-water farms still function (wiki doesn't address AFK explicitly).
tricks.confidence: medium - mechanics high; still-viable claim is community knowledge

tricks.name: Super-smelter (furnace array)
tricks.what: Hopper-fed row of furnaces sharing input, fuel and output chests.
steps: Place 8-16 furnaces in a row
Hopper minecart / hopper line splits input on top, fuel from side
Output hoppers into a chest
tricks.why: Smelts stacks in seconds-per-item divided by furnace count; pairs with lava/kelp fuel.

tricks.name: Dried kelp block fuel loop
tricks.what: Smelt kelp into dried kelp, craft blocks; each block smelts 20 items (net positive fuel).
steps: Collect kelp
Smelt -> dried_kelp
9 -> dried_kelp_block
Use as fuel
tricks.why: Renewable fuel from oceans before a lava source; 20 smelts per block.

tricks.name: Beacon with Haste II at the mining base
tricks.what: Kill the Wither, place a beacon on a full pyramid, choose Haste II (or Speed) for instant mining.
steps: Kill Wither -> nether_star
Build pyramid (e.g. 164 blocks for tier 4 - iron/gold/emerald/diamond/netherite)
Select Haste + Haste II (tier 4)
tricks.why: Haste II + Efficiency V netherite pick insta-mines stone, massively speeds digging perimeters for farms.

tricks.name: Trap the Wither under bedrock
tricks.what: Spawn the Wither where it can't move or blow up its surroundings (e.g. under the End exit portal bedrock or Nether ceiling) and kill it with a Smite sword.
steps: Prepare Smite V sword, potions
Build soul sand + skulls so the Wither spawns with its head in bedrock
Kill it while it's stuck
tricks.why: Safe, repeatable nether stars for beacons.
tricks.confidence: medium - exact cage designs vary by version; verify on a video before using

tricks.name: Boat / minecart mob transport
tricks.what: Pull mobs (villagers, zombies for curing, a pillager for raid farms) in boats or minecarts.
steps: Get mob into boat
Paddle or place-and-break track to drag
Use leads for passive mobs
tricks.why: Starts trading halls, zombie-cure stations, iron farms without breeding.

tricks.name: Ride a strider across Nether lava
tricks.what: Saddle a strider and steer it with a warped fungus on a stick to cross lava oceans.
steps: Find strider
Put saddle on
Craft warped_fungus_on_a_stick
Ride across lava
tricks.why: Safe lava crossing (7.34 m/s boosted) without fire resistance.

tricks.name: Grow a happy ghast (flying build platform)
tricks.what: Waterlog a dried ghast block, grow the ghastling (feed snowballs), harness it, and use it as a flying platform for up to 4 players.
steps: Get dried_ghast (soul sand valley)
Waterlog it ~20 min
Grow ghastling 20 min (each snowball -10% remaining time)
Craft harness, mount
tricks.why: Hovering scaffold for building tall farms/perimeters; ~3.6 m/s flight (slow travel).
tricks.version_notes: Added 1.21.6.

tricks.name: Riptide trident travel in rain/water
tricks.what: Use a Riptide trident to launch yourself in rain or water; combine with elytra.
steps: Get trident (drowned)
Enchant Riptide III
Hold and release while in rain/water
tricks.why: Fast launches; rain + elytra rocket-free flight.

tricks.name: Wind charges for jumps and fall saving
tricks.what: Throw wind charges at your feet to launch up; mace + wind charges for combat.
steps: Get breeze_rod from trial chambers
Craft 4 wind_charge per rod
Throw at ground to launch
tricks.why: Climb cliffs, cross gaps, start elytra flights without rockets.

tricks.name: Brewing station with key potions
tricks.what: Set up brewing stand + water source; brew fire resistance, night vision, slow falling, weakness (for curing).
steps: Get blaze rods (fuel + stand)
Nether wart farm
Brew awkward potions -> magma cream (fire res), etc.
tricks.why: Fire resistance makes Nether/lava work safe; weakness enables zombie curing.
tricks.needs: Fortress for blaze rods + nether wart.

tricks.name: Spawn-proof / light the base area
tricks.what: Light the base and use slabs/carpet so hostile mobs don't spawn near your farms and storage.
steps: Light areas to block light 1+ (hostiles need 0 in 1.18+)
Bottom slabs or glass on dark surfaces
Fence or wall the base
tricks.why: Safety and keeps mob cap free for mob farms.
tricks.version_notes: 1.18+: hostile mobs need block light 0 to spawn.

tricks.name: Buy explorer/village maps from cartographers
tricks.what: Trade with a cartographer for maps that point to structures (ocean monument, woodland mansion, trial chambers, biome villages).
steps: Get a cartography_table villager
Level it up
Buy the map you need
tricks.why: Direct route to monuments/mansions/trial chambers instead of searching.
tricks.version_notes: 1.21.5 shipped biome-dependent cartographer maps (village maps by biome, jungle/swamp explorer maps, trial explorer map).

tricks.name: Plan with a seed map (Chunkbase) and stronghold finder
tricks.what: Use your world seed with Chunkbase to locate slime chunks, strongholds, villages, biomes and structures before travelling; triangulate the stronghold with two eye throws.
steps: /seed in single player
Open chunkbase.com app
Plan portal links and farm locations (slime chunks, ocean monuments, witch huts)
tricks.why: Turns 'finding X' into direct travel; essential for picking ianxofour farm sites.
tricks.needs: Seed access (SP or server owner). Some consider it cheating.
tricks.confidence: high - tools referenced in ianxofour's mob switch description

tricks.name: Win a raid for Hero of the Village discounts
tricks.what: Defeat a raid at your trading hall village to get Hero of the Village, then do bulk buying while it lasts.
steps: Get Bad Omen (ominous bottle)
Trigger raid at your village
Win
Trade immediately while the effect lasts
tricks.why: Temporary extra discounts stacked on top of curing discounts.

tricks.name: Lodestone compasses for base navigation (incl. Nether)
tricks.what: Place a lodestone at key points and link compasses so they point there in any dimension.
steps: Craft lodestone (chiseled stone bricks + netherite ingot)
Right-click with compass
tricks.why: Compasses that work in the Nether to find your portal hub.
tricks.needs: Netherite ingot (recipe changed in 1.21.5 to use iron ingot - inferred, verify).
tricks.confidence: medium - recent recipe change not verified

tricks.name: Elytra 'ride share' tow from water (ianxofour)
tricks.what: Take off from water with Dolphin's Grace + Depth Strider while towing a saddled pig/player on a lead, sharing one elytra.
steps: Open elytra while swimming on surface, looking up slightly
Accelerate with Dolphin's Grace (or a rocket to ~28 b/s)
Pitch to -35 degrees and fire rockets
tricks.why: Multiple players share one set of wings; fun more than optimal.
tricks.version_notes: 1.16-1.19 era; dangerous.

tricks.name: TNT duper for digging perimeters / tunnel bores
tricks.what: Build a slime-and-coral TNT duper that copies one TNT forever; use it in flying machines or world eaters to clear huge areas for farms.
steps: Follow a known 1.21 duper design
Mount on a flying machine for a tunnel bore or world eater
Use for nether roof perimeters, slime/witch perimeters
tricks.why: Clears perimeters for mob farms without hand-digging; powers ianxofour-style big builds.
